author: bardic-inspiration
name: Cairn Giant
summary: A towering giant held together by lashed bones and mortared stones, its chest a burial mound with something still breathing inside.
description: The cairn builders were the first to bury their heroes under rock. The rock got up some centuries later and took a skeleton along for the walk.

traits.name: Barrow Aura
traits.text: The first time on a turn that a creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the giant, it takes {dmg:1d8:necrotic}.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two Cairn Maul attacks, or one Cairn Maul attack and uses Grave Toss.

reactions.name: Settle
reactions.text: Trigger: The giant takes damage that would reduce it to 0 Hit Points. Response: The giant makes a {dc:con} Constitution saving throw. On a success, it drops to 1 Hit Point instead. It can't use this reaction again until it finishes a Long Rest.
